errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста са представени за всяка година.
errors.evidence: The labels on the X-axis (Година/Year) are not for every year, but are shown at 5-year intervals (2003, 2008, 2013, 2018, 2023).
The blue line representing 'Брой държави в света' is solid (плътна), not dashed/interrupted (прекъсната).
The line representing 'Брой държави в Европа' is orange, not red (червена), and it is solid (плътна), not dashed/interrupted (прекъсната).
The description completely omits the two dotted trend lines ('Linear (Брой държави в света)' and 'Linear (Брой държави в Европа)') that are present in the chart and legend.
The blue line starts at a value of 10 in 2003, not 16. The value 16 is reached around the year 2004.
For the blue line, the value in 2008 is 14, not 10. The line drops to 10 around the year 2010.
The last data point for the blue line is 57, but this value is reached around the year 2021, not 2023. The data series does not extend to 2023.
For the orange line, the value in 2008 is 9, not 6. The line drops to a minimum of 6 around the year 2010.
The orange line does not have a value of 16 in 2008 (it is 9). While the value is 16 around 2012 and 2014, it is not repeated at the specified years of 2008 and 2013.
